summary: One church (Mater Ecclesiae, traditional Latin Mass). Both November 2026 bulletins print the same week: Sat 5 PM, Sun 8 and 10:30 AM (Benediction after), Mon-Tue/Thu-Sat 8 AM, Wed 7:30 PM, with confessions before each Mass; the homepage's Mass Times agree, with slightly different confession minutes (bulletin used). First Friday all-day Adoration comes from the website (R6). Open: the website-only Saturday 4-4:55 PM and First Friday 7:30 AM confessions.
